instruction: My siblings and I are preparing a playlist for a roadtrip together. I prepared the initial playlist on Spotify and shared it with them on phone messages. They have replied with suggested changes. Please update this playlist accordingly.
notes: Siblings are discovered via phone.search_contacts(relationship='sibling'); their replies (suggested additions/removals) are read with phone.search_text_messages per sibling phone number. The model uses two representative siblings: one suggesting a song to add, one suggesting a song to remove; in general the add/remove actions repeat per suggested song. The playlist id is obtained from the Spotify playlist library, song ids to remove from show_playlist, and song ids to add from search_songs. Goal demands exactly the suggested additions/removals on the target playlist (only spotify.PlaylistSong changes) and task completion with no answer; supervisor-complete-task takes the playlist and the two songs as task-record parameters (not API arguments) so its precondition can restate the goal.
